prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1386; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the knee injury described, and the presentation is plausible for a collision of this type. Over the course of 19 visits, care included physical examination, imaging review, a structured rehabilitation program, and activity modification. The treatment course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing and symptoms easing as the patient improved. Some examination findings, including joint line tenderness and reduced flexion, support the reported injury, while other orthopedic tests and neurovascular checks were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same knee is known from the patient history. Billing records show two similar charges on the same date of service, which are currently under review for accuracy and duplication. Ongoing monitoring and a home exercise plan were recommended at discharge from active care.
